response.justification: Strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, but the profile is a poor match for this role's core requirements. The position demands 8 years of C++ programming; the resume shows only roughly six months of professional C/C++ work at National Instruments (2014–2015) plus a university thesis project. Experience is concentrated in web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, Ember, D), with one relevant stint in high-throughput microservices at Sociomantic. There is no evidence of building or leading large-scale cloud compute platforms, hardware/storage architecture, or holding a formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. Mentoring and community-teaching credentials are genuine but not equivalent to the platform-scale technical leadership sought here.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic (millions of req/sec)
Demonstrated mentoring, workshops, and open-source tooling/test-framework authorship
Broad polyglot, full-stack range with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS CDK, and CI/CD experience
concerns: Far short of the 8-year C++ requirement (~6 months professional C/C++)
No large-scale cloud compute platform or hardware/storage architecture experience
No formal technical leadership role owning strategy, priorities, and cross-team alignment

key_factors.factor: Cloud compute platform / large-scale infrastructure experience
Distributed systems and mentoring track record
